budget_family_selection: TRAIN80 maximum good-image count at fixed budget; ties retain predeclared family order

scientific_choices.choice: Local paper sections3.3/3.5 and Algorithm2 route uncertain whole images to DeepSolo. The proposed YOLO consistency rules are external extensions, not the paper algorithm.

Reuse the audited640/960 YOLO/PARSeq/CLIP features, predicted Text/Kernel coverage, frozen425 complete ViTAEv2-S+TextOCR fallback branches, original RGB hashes, strict qualified PARSeq checkpoint/runtime and TRAIN80/45 partition.

All networks stay frozen. Retain exactly the original640 word outputs and metric. Scale and perturbed crop readings are routing probes only; never replace/correct/filter final words with their outputs.

Scale agreement is maximum-cardinality one-to-one exact-casefold word plus bboxIoU>=0.5 agreement, with secondary maximum IoU; normalize as2matches/(n640+n960). Empty OCR cannot bypass. Matching preserves punctuation and duplicates.

Probe original640 boxes with fixed5% shrink/expansion. Compute fraction of words unchanged in both views and mean minimum normalized Levenshtein agreement. Reuse pixel-verified TEST views; obtain the missing TRAIN views using identical CPU FP32 PARSeq. Changed-crop accuracy is not the final output accuracy.

Compare predeclared score families only: native/CLIP controls, existing coverage mixture, separate scale/crop/coverage controls, fixed geometric means and a minimum/AND score. No learned classifier, backbone update, embedding optimization or fitted mixture weights.

An image is good if its actual local word F1>=0.8. Choose a family on TRAIN80 by maximum accepted count meeting empirical quality target, then larger good fraction and predeclared order; independently calibrate every family threshold on TRAIN45 with at least5 acceptances. Freeze all thresholds before new TEST consistency features. Report all families/targets plus the TRAIN-selected family; no TEST selection.

Targets80/90/95% describe fraction of accepted images having F1>=0.8, distinct from F1 itself. If no empirical calibration threshold exists, abstain on every image. Transfer scalar thresholds; separately describe GT-free10/20/30/40/50% batch rank budgets. Report zero-bypass results and all denominators. Empirical calibration has no formal risk guarantee.

PAPER actual hardware recorded. Additional OCR runs CPU FP32 batch32/four threads, matching the cached views rather than switching numerical backend. All detector/CLIP/U-Net/DeepSolo inference is reused with original provenance. Record model state hash before/after, shapes, memory fields null for CPU, actual failures/OOM; install nothing.

Stability can preserve a consistently wrong or incomplete reading; coverage maps can miss text. Only45 calibration images and historically explored TEST prevent strong guarantees. A good light branch need not outperform DeepSolo. Final whole-system F1 is evaluated separately. Strict paper metric/artifacts and8GB qualification remain unresolved.
